items.exampleEn: Is this kind of growth sustainable over the next ten years?
items.exampleZh: 這種成長在未來十年能持續下去嗎？

items.exampleEn: Volunteers work hard to conserve the old forest near our town.
items.exampleZh: 志工們努力保護我們鎮附近的那片老森林。

items.exampleEn: The old kitchen really needs better ventilation.
items.exampleZh: 這間舊廚房真的需要更好的通風。

items.exampleEn: This liquid neutralizes any acid that is spilled in the lab.
items.exampleZh: 這種液體能中和實驗室裡灑出來的酸。

items.exampleEn: Working eighty hours a week is simply unsustainable.
items.exampleZh: 一週工作八十個小時，根本撐不下去。
items.glossZh: 無法持續的；不可持續的

items.exampleEn: The village lives sustainably by growing its own food.
items.exampleZh: 這個村子自己種植糧食，過著永續的生活。

items.exampleEn: Some forests are being cut down unsustainably.
items.exampleZh: 有些森林正以無法持續的方式被砍伐。

items.sentenceEn: Good ventilation keeps the classroom air fresh.
items.sentenceZh: 良好的通風讓教室的空氣保持清新。

items.audioEn: We turn off the lights in empty rooms to conserve energy.
items.audioZh: 我們會關掉空房間的燈來節約能源。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼關掉空房間的燈？

items.sentenceEn: Fishing at this rate is unsustainable.
items.sentenceZh: 照這種速度捕魚，是無法持續下去的。

items.sentenceEn: This table is made from wood grown sustainably.
items.sentenceZh: 這張桌子是用永續種植的木材做的。

items.stemEn: The company wants a ____ business that does not harm the planet.
items.stemZh: 這家公司希望經營不傷害地球的永續事業。

items.stemEn: To ____ the acid in the water, the team added a special powder.
items.stemZh: 為了中和水中的酸性，團隊加入了一種特殊粉末。

items.passageEn: Our school has started a project to become more sustainable. Students noticed that the old classrooms used energy unsustainably: lights stayed on all day, and fans ran even in empty rooms. Now each class has two students who switch things off. To conserve electricity while keeping the air fresh, the school improved natural ventilation by opening windows on both sides of each room. In the garden, students grow vegetable seedlings and add crushed egg shells to the soil to neutralize acid. The principal says the old habits were simply unsustainable.
items.passageZh: 我們學校開始了一項計畫，讓學校變得更永續。學生發現，舊教室用電的方式根本無法持續：燈整天開著，連空教室的電扇都在轉。現在每班都有兩位同學負責關電。為了節省用電、同時保持空氣清新，學校打開每間教室兩側的窗戶，改善自然通風。在菜園裡，學生種下蔬菜幼苗，並在土裡加入壓碎的蛋殼來中和酸性。校長說，舊的習慣根本無法持續下去。

options: 在每間教室裝設新的大型電扇

questions.questionZh: 學生為什麼在土裡加入蛋殼？
options: 讓菜園看起來比較漂亮

items.promptZh: 乾季時，大家都需要節約用水。
referenceEn: We all need to conserve water during the dry season.
Everyone should try to conserve water in the dry season.
rubricZh: conserve 表示「節約、保護」（例如 conserve water 等）
「乾季時」可寫，例如 during the dry season、in the dry season 等
「需要」可寫，例如 need to、should 等

items.promptZh: 這家咖啡店只用可永續生產的咖啡豆。
referenceEn: This cafe only uses coffee beans that are grown in a sustainable way.
The cafe uses only sustainable coffee beans.
rubricZh: 「可永續生產的」用 sustainable（例如 sustainable coffee beans、grown in a sustainable way 等）
「只用」可寫，例如 only uses、uses only 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：conserve rare birds 搭配略生硬（較常說 protect rare birds／conserve wildlife、conserve the habitat of rare birds）；可接受但不夠道地。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改 Volunteers work hard to conserve the old forest near our town.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：只看英文時 suburban 也成立（a suburban business）；nocturnal 也有點說得通
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: suburban 換 panoramic、nocturnal 換 climactic，代入後都不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 15：聽選本批正解集中在最長與最短
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 調整選項長度，正解改為第 2 長

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：conserve 表示「節約、保護」（例如 conserve water 等）／「乾季時」可寫，例如 during the dry season、in the dry season 等／「需要」可寫，例如 need to、should 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：sustainable 表示「可持續的、永續的」，位置有彈性（例如 a sustainable habit、is sustainable 等）／句子要說到你自己的習慣

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（sustainable）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u19-l01-q16；目標字沿用 sustainable
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這家咖啡店只用可永續生產的咖啡豆。」、hintWords ["sustainable"]、referenceEn ["This cafe only uses coffee beans that are grown in a sustainable way.","The cafe uses only sustainable coffee beans."]、rubricZh ["「可永續生產的」用 sustainable（例如 sustainable coffee beans、grown in a sustainable way 等）","「只用」可寫，例如 only uses、uses only 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 sustainable 造一個句子，說說你生活中一個比較環保、能長久持續的習慣。」、referenceEn ["Taking my own bag when I go shopping is a small sustainable habit.","I try to buy sustainable products, such as clothes made from recycled cotton."]）
